name: delegate_to_opencode
description: Have OpenCode, a coding agent working inside your worktree, make a change. Give precise instructions: what to change, where, and how it will be verified. One concern per call. It reads and edits files itself; do not ask it to commit, push or open pull requests. Returns its summary and the files that changed.

repo.description: The slot OpenCode works in: its name, or the repository's address. Leave out when the workspace has one.
